rules: Backlog is required before meaningful implementation.
Every meaningful code, docs, extension, or workflow change must map to an issue_id.
Builder may reason, but must not modify files without explicit human approval.
QA and validation must be deterministic whenever possible.
Project-specific memory must live in the target project, not globally in Kajiya Build Line.

items.title: Define project vision, backlog, and handoff protocol
items.problem: The repository exists and has an initial Pi extension, but it needs a canonical objective, backlog, and handoff protocol so work can resume without relying on chat memory.
items.expected_behavior: A new session can read README.md, docs/state/backlog.json, docs/state/current-project.json, and docs/LLM_HANDOFF_PROTOCOL.md to understand the project and next safe actions.
close_criteria: README explains the project purpose and relationship to Kajiya Context Engine.
Backlog exists and includes initial KBL issues.

items.title: Formalize kajiya_onboard_project as the first read-only pi.dev
items.problem: The local Pi extension can inject an onboarding prompt, but the onboarding station needs to be formalized as the first permanent pi.dev-style step.
items.expected_behavior: Running /kajiya-onboard in Pi starts a read-only project discovery step that inspects the current repo and returns JSON-compatible readiness output.
close_criteria: The onboarding prompt does not assume any specific project.

items.title: Add project profile initialization with explicit confirmation
items.problem: Kajiya Build Line needs a way to initialize project-local identity without contaminating global memory.
items.expected_behavior: A confirmed init step creates .kajiya/project.json with project-local paths, validation commands, memory policy, and external write policy.
close_criteria: Generated profile contains no machine-specific secrets.

items.title: Add deterministic status and QA commands
items.problem: The build line needs deterministic checks before and after Builder-assisted work.
items.expected_behavior: Commands can inspect git status, compile Python sources, check expected files, and report JSON without LLM reasoning.
close_criteria: Status works from an external git repo.

items.title: Design Builder as bounded Pi/Pocock reasoning step
items.problem: The project needs a Builder step that uses Pi/Pocock's configured model without adding a separate Gemini SDK client.
items.expected_behavior: The Builder receives a selected issue_id and local evidence, then returns a structured patch plan without modifying files.
close_criteria: Builder does not run before backlog issue selection.
Builder does not use Gemini SDK directly.
Builder cannot claim files changed unless a deterministic step changed them.

items.title: Add deterministic issue transition and close command
items.problem: Issue closure and workstream transitions are currently performed with long ad-hoc Python snippets pasted into the terminal, which is not replicable or aligned with Kajiya Build Line.
items.expected_behavior: A deterministic command can close one backlog issue, attach evidence, activate the next issue, update current-project state, and return JSON-compatible output.
close_criteria: A backlog issue can be closed without a custom pasted Python script.
The next issue can be activated deterministically.
Evidence paths can be attached to the closed issue.

items.title: Add deterministic evidence collection command
items.problem: The operator wants to ask Kajiya Build Line to gather outputs from files, scripts, grep searches, directory listings, and git state without relying on free-form shell commands invented by the LLM.
items.expected_behavior: A deterministic command can collect requested evidence from safe read-only operations and return JSON-compatible output for Builder or human review.
validation_commands: kajiya-build-line evidence --read docs/state/backlog.json --list src/kajiya_build_line --grep close_issue --grep-path src --git-log 5
close_criteria: Evidence command supports safe file reads.
Evidence command supports grep over an explicit path.
Evidence command supports git log summary.

items.title: Add human-authored task brief command
items.problem: The operator needs a deterministic way to record a human-authored surgical instruction for the Builder, based on evidence reviewed by humans, instead of sending raw evidence or broad context to the LLM.
items.expected_behavior: A deterministic command creates a task brief JSON file containing issue_id, human instruction, evidence references, allowed files, forbidden actions, and validation commands.
proposed_change: Do not modify source code beyond creating the brief file.
validation_commands: kajiya-build-line task-brief --issue-id KBL-008 --instruction "Implement task-brief command. Do not modify Pi extension." --evidence docs/evidence/kbl-007-evidence-command.md --allowed-file src/kajiya_build_line/cli.py --allowed-file src/kajiya_build_line/task_brief.py --validation "kajiya-build-line qa"

items.title: Add JSON Schema validation command
items.problem: Kajiya Build Line now has multiple durable JSON artifacts and JSON-producing commands, but it does not yet validate them against their JSON Schemas.
items.expected_behavior: A deterministic read-only command validates key project JSON artifacts against schemas and returns JSON-compatible validation results.
proposed_change: Validate a generated evidence payload against docs/schemas/kajiya-evidence.schema.json.
close_criteria: Project profile validates against its schema.
Task brief validates against its schema.
Evidence payload validates against its schema.

items.title: Refactor CLI command routing to argparse subparsers
items.problem: The CLI routing is currently hand-written with string comparisons and has been patched through fragile text replacements. This caused a bug where validate-json appeared in usage text but was not actually dispatched.
items.expected_behavior: The CLI uses argparse subparsers so each command registers its parser and handler in one deterministic routing table.
proposed_change: Refactor src/kajiya_build_line/cli.py to use argparse.ArgumentParser and add_subparsers.
Preserve existing commands: status, qa, evidence, task-brief, close-issue, validate-json.
Do not change command behavior beyond routing.
Add evidence documenting that every command still works.
validation_commands: kajiya-build-line evidence --read docs/state/backlog.json --list src/kajiya_build_line --grep close_issue --grep-path src --git-log 5

kajiya-build-line task-brief --issue-id KBL-010 --instruction "Refactor CLI routing to argparse subparsers without changing command behavior." --evidence docs/evidence/kbl-009-validate-json-command.md --allowed-file src/kajiya_build_line/cli.py --validation "kajiya-build-line qa"

items.title: Add JSON Schema validation into QA
items.problem: The validate-json command exists and passes, but kajiya-build-line qa does not yet run schema validation as part of the standard deterministic QA gate.
items.expected_behavior: Running kajiya-build-line qa includes JSON Schema validation and fails if validate-json fails.
proposed_change: Add a json_schema_validation check to QA output.
Preserve existing git_diff_check and python_compileall_src checks.
Ensure qa returns ok false if schema validation fails.
close_criteria: QA fails if schema validation fails.

items.title: Add compact status summary command
items.problem: Kajiya Build Line commands return correct JSON, but status and QA outputs are too large for quick operator decision-making.
items.expected_behavior: A deterministic summary command returns a compact JSON dashboard with active issue, dirty state, QA status, validation status, backlog counts, and next recommended action.
proposed_change: Use existing status, qa, and validate-json payload builders.

items.title: Add next command for operator guidance
items.problem: Kajiya Build Line can show compact summary, but the operator still needs a direct command that answers what to do next without reading full status output.
items.expected_behavior: A deterministic next command returns the current recommended operator action, active issue if any, safe commands, and whether the repo is ready for the next backlog decision.

items.title: Clear active issue when closing without next issue
items.problem: After closing an issue without --next-issue-id, current-project still reports the closed issue as active_issue_id while next_recommended_action says to select the next backlog item.
items.expected_behavior: When close-issue is called without --next-issue-id, current-project active_issue_id is cleared and active_workstream reflects backlog selection mode.
proposed_change: If next_issue_id is omitted, set current-project active_issue_id to null.
Keep next_recommended_action as Select the next backlog item.
Preserve existing behavior when next_issue_id is provided.
close_criteria: close-issue clears active_issue_id when no next_issue_id is provided.
summary shows active_issue_id null after closing with no next issue.
next shows select_backlog_item mode after closing with no next issue.
Existing next_issue_id activation behavior remains intact.

items.title: Add init-project command for bootstrapping Build Line into another repo
items.problem: Kajiya Build Line works inside its own repository, but there is not yet a deterministic command to initialize the required project files inside another repository.
items.expected_behavior: A local-write command can initialize a target repository with project-local Kajiya files: project profile, backlog, current-project state, handoff protocol, evidence folder, task-briefs folder, and basic schemas.
proposed_change: Default target root is current working directory.
Do not overwrite existing files unless a future explicit flag is added.
close_criteria: Command creates project-local state files in a target repo.
Command refuses to overwrite existing files by default.

items.title: Add bootstrap-check command for repo readiness detection
items.problem: Before running init-project in another repository, the operator needs a read-only command that detects whether the repo is already initialized or missing Kajiya Build Line files.
items.expected_behavior: A deterministic bootstrap-check command inspects the current repository and reports initialized status, present files, missing files, conflicts, and recommended next action.
proposed_change: Check required files without modifying anything.
Recommend init-project when required files are missing.
Recommend normal next/summary flow when initialized.
close_criteria: bootstrap-check reports initialized true in this repo.
bootstrap-check reports missing files in an uninitialized temp repo.

items.title: Document Pi runtime boundary and Kajiya Build Line differentiation
items.problem: Kajiya Build Line is built on top of Pi/Pocock, but the repository does not yet clearly document how it differs from Pi coding-agent docs and why Pi remains the selected coding agent runtime.
items.expected_behavior: A decision document explains that Pi is the interactive coding-agent runtime while Kajiya Build Line is the deterministic project governance layer for backlog, evidence, task briefs, JSON schemas, QA, and portable project memory.
proposed_change: Document what Pi provides: coding agent runtime, extensions, skills, prompt templates, packages, JSON/RPC mode.
Document what Kajiya Build Line provides: deterministic project-local state, schemas, backlog, evidence, task briefs, QA, close-issue, bootstrap.
Document future regenerative-agent/lambda concept with safety constraints.
Document that self-modification must be bounded by task brief, allowed files, QA, JSON Schema, diff review, and git commit.
Document why Datomic-style JSON modeling matters for future migration and agent-safe memory.
close_criteria: Decision clearly states Pi is the selected coding agent runtime.
Decision clearly states Kajiya Build Line is not replacing Pi.
Decision explains deterministic layer vs LLM reasoning layer.
Decision mentions JSON Schema and Datomic-style modeling rationale.

items.title: Add AGENTS.md and upstream improvement protocol to project bootstrap
items.problem: Bootstrapped repositories get Kajiya Build Line project files, but they do not yet get a root-level AGENTS.md explaining how Pi/coding agents should behave or how improvements discovered in child repos should be proposed back to the main kajiya-build-line repository.
items.expected_behavior: init-project creates AGENTS.md with Kajiya Build Line operating rules, Pi runtime guidance, deterministic-first workflow, and upstream improvement protocol for proposing PRs back to the main Build Line repo.
proposed_change: Document Pi uses AGENTS.md as repo-level agent instructions.
Add upstream improvement protocol to AGENTS.md.
Explain that child repos should not silently fork Kajiya Build Line behavior.
Explain that reusable improvements should be proposed to the main kajiya-build-line repo.
Add evidence documenting AGENTS.md bootstrap behavior.
Ensure init-project refuses to overwrite AGENTS.md if it already exists.
close_criteria: init-project creates AGENTS.md in new repos.
AGENTS.md explains Pi is the coding-agent runtime.
AGENTS.md explains Kajiya Build Line deterministic workflow.
init-project blocks rather than overwrites existing AGENTS.md.

items.title: Fix AGENTS.md bootstrap regression
items.problem: KBL-018 claimed init-project creates AGENTS.md, but validation in a temporary repo showed AGENTS.md was not created and was not listed in created_files.
items.expected_behavior: init-project creates AGENTS.md in new repositories, includes it in created_files, and blocks on second init-project because AGENTS.md exists.
proposed_change: Add a real build_agents_md generator if missing.
Ensure AGENTS.md appears in conflicts on second init-project.
Correct evidence by documenting the original failed validation and the fix.
validation_commands: TMP_REPO=$(mktemp -d) && cd "$TMP_REPO" && git init && kajiya-build-line init-project --project-id temp-agents-fix --project-name "Temp AGENTS Fix" --project-type software_project
close_criteria: AGENTS.md is created in a fresh temp repo.
Second init-project reports AGENTS.md as a conflict.
Evidence documents the earlier failed KBL-018 validation.

items.title: Add upstream improvement proposal command
items.problem: Child repositories can discover reusable improvements to Kajiya Build Line, but there is no deterministic command to record those improvements as upstream proposal artifacts for the main kajiya-build-line repository.
items.expected_behavior: A deterministic command creates an upstream improvement proposal JSON artifact containing source project, title, problem, recommendation, evidence references, suggested target files, and validation commands.
proposed_change: Do not modify source code beyond creating the proposal artifact.
Document that proposal artifacts can be used to open issues or PRs in the main kajiya-build-line repo.
validation_commands: kajiya-build-line upstream-improvement --title "Fix AGENTS bootstrap regression" --source-project kajiya-build-line --problem "init-project had AGENTS generator but did not write AGENTS.md" --recommendation "Add AGENTS.md to planned_text_files and validate in temp repo" --evidence docs/evidence/kbl-019-fix-agents-bootstrap-regression.md --target-file src/kajiya_build_line/init_project.py --validation "kajiya-build-line qa"
